title: Magma Craft
description: A content mod adding the Volcanic Wasteland biome, protective Magma Armor, and a Magma Altar to summon a powerful boss who drops the high-damage Magma Sword!
body:
# Magma Craft

Welcome to **Magma Craft**, a content expansion that brings a hot and dangerous challenge to your Minecraft world! Explore a harsh new environment, gather rare volcanic resources, and prepare for a tough battle.

### Features:
* **New Biome - Volcanic Wasteland:** A scorching biome fully generated with unique rock layers—`Volcanic Stone` and `Deep Volcanic Stone`. 
* **Magma Resources:** Mine rare `Magma Ore` deep within the wasteland to forge a powerful set of `Magma Armor` for high protection.
* **The Ritual & The Boss:** Build and activate the custom `Magma Altar`. Doing so summons the powerful **Magma Boss**, a giant enemy that will test your combat skills.
* **Legendary Reward:** Defeat the boss to claim the **Magma Sword**—the ultimate weapon in the mod that deals massive damage to your enemies!
